find the nearest neighbour of each cell

Source: R/cell_differences.R
find_nearest_neighbours.Rd

After running pairwise_bin_difference(), we can feed that output dataframe to this function to find the nearest neighbour of each cell. The pairwise function does the comparisons in a non-redundant way (A-B, A-C, B-C), leaving out some redundant comparisons (i.e., C-A, C-B). If A's nearest neighbour is C, it's not guaranteed that C's nearest neighbour is A. This function takes a cell specific focus and finds the nearest neighbour of each.

Usage

find_nearest_neighbours(pairwise_diffs)

Arguments

pairwise_diffs

tibble output of pairwise_bin_difference()

Value

tibble/dataframe

Details

As with pairwise_bin_difference(), using furrr::future_map() internally, so speed improvements with a future::plan() being set.
